svg.title: Focus and learning
svg.desc: CURRENT COORDINATES: Web security & penetration testing, Vulnerability assessment & code review, OSINT & digital-footprint security, Malware, reverse engineering & binaries, Cryptography fundamentals, Linux, networks & backend development; NEXT HORIZONS: Advanced web application security, Malware analysis & reverse engineering, Linux hardening & network security, Secure APIs & backend architecture
svg.text: There is always more to discover.
A flight plan through practical security research and secure backend development.
LEARNING IS THE MISSION. CURIOSITY IS THE PROPULSION.
